observations.body: Jesus contrasts the good shepherd with the hired hand, speaks of knowing the sheep, gathering one flock, laying down his life, and taking it again by received command.

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, shepherd, sheep visible within its Crucifixion evidence.

payload.posture: Read John 10:11–18 as its own anticipation and stated approach crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
